sections.heading: 1. Work
points: In science, **work is done** when a **force** moves an object through a **distance in the direction of the force**.
**Work = Force × displacement (W = F × s)**; SI unit = **joule (J)** (1 J = 1 N·m).
Work is **zero** if there is no displacement, or if force is **perpendicular** to motion (e.g. carrying a bag while walking).
Work can be **positive** (force and motion same direction) or **negative** (opposite, e.g. friction).

sections.heading: 2. Energy
points: **Energy** = the **capacity to do work**; SI unit = **joule (J)**.
**Kinetic energy (KE)** = energy of motion = **½mv²**.
**Potential energy (PE)** = energy due to position/height = **mgh** (gravitational).
Energy exists in many forms (mechanical, heat, light, sound, chemical, electrical, nuclear) and can be **transformed** from one to another.

sections.heading: 3. Conservation of Energy and Power
points: **Law of conservation of energy:** energy can **neither be created nor destroyed**, only **transformed**; the total energy stays constant.
Example: a falling body — PE converts to KE (total remains constant).
**Power = rate of doing work = Work ÷ Time**; SI unit = **watt (W)** (1 W = 1 J/s).
**1 kilowatt-hour (kWh) = 1 'unit' of electricity** (commercial unit of energy).

sections.heading: 4. Simple Machines
points: **Simple machines** make work easier: **lever, pulley, inclined plane, wheel and axle, screw, wedge**.
They change the **direction or magnitude** of force (mechanical advantage), but not the total work done.
Levers have three classes based on positions of **load, effort and fulcrum**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Work = Force × displacement (joule); zero if no displacement or force ⊥ motion.
Energy = capacity to do work (joule); KE = ½mv²; PE = mgh.
Conservation of energy: neither created nor destroyed, only transformed.
Power = work ÷ time (watt); 1 kWh = 1 unit of electricity.
Simple machines: lever, pulley, inclined plane, wheel & axle, screw, wedge.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **No work is done** if there is **no displacement** or if force is **perpendicular** to the displacement.
**KE = ½mv²**; **PE = mgh**.
Energy is only **transformed**, never created or destroyed.
**Power = work/time** (watt); **1 kWh** is the commercial unit ('one unit') of energy.
